summary: Iteration 97 - Inventory Module (Módulo de Control de Inventarios Multialmacén): All 19 backend tests passed (100%) and all frontend UI elements verified working correctly. Tested warehouse CRUD, entry operations with type-based validation (general=quantity only, hardware=serials required), stock calculation using algebraic formula, exit operations with stock/serial validation, atomic transfers between warehouses, movement history, and serial parsing endpoint.

_get_item_stock helper function properly calculates real-time stock by aggregating all movements
Transfer operation creates paired movements atomically (transferencia_salida + transferencia_entrada)
Serial validation checks for duplicates across all warehouses before allowing entry
